### Gap 1 — Tuple aliases (Cause H) — primitive-only whitelist duplicated across 5 renderers

**Renderers involved:** R1 (lines 16042-16077), R2 (6092-6112), R3 (7327-7347), R5 (7707-7727), R7 (15804-15843)

**Sky code affected:**
```elm
makePair : Foo -> Bar -> (Foo, Bar)
makePair f b = (f, b)
```

**Emitted Go today:**
```go
func Main_makePair(f any, b any) rt.SkyTuple2 {
    return rt.SkyTuple2{V0: f, V1: b}
}
```
Element types collapse to `any` because `Foo` / `Bar` fail the primitive-only whitelist (`isPrimitive ∈ {"string","int",...}`); `rt.SkyTuple2 = T2[any, any]`.

**Emitted Go fully-typed:**
```go
func Main_makePair(f Main_Foo, b Main_Bar) rt.T2[Main_Foo, Main_Bar] {
    return rt.T2[Main_Foo, Main_Bar]{V0: f, V1: b}
}
```

**Architectural dependency:** Gaps 2 + 3 + 5 must close first. The Strategy-C documented blocker (`docs/v0.17-cause-h-step4-blocker.md` lines 113-188) proves single-site widening at R1 fails (asymmetry vs R2/R3/R5/R7) AND five-site widening fails (`<<loop>>` via `inferTypeFromGoString` → `solvedTypeToGo` cycle through `lowerTypedLambda` at Compile.hs:8131). ### Gap 2 — `inferTypeFromGoString` lossy round-trip (the consumer-side cycle)

**Renderer-adjacent site:** `inferTypeFromGoString` (Compile.hs:8156-8163) — only handles 5 primitives; every other shape returns `T.TVar "_"`.

**Sky code affected:**
```elm
inner : Int -> Int
inner n = n * 2

outer : (Int -> Int) -> Int -> Int
outer f n = f n
```
When `outer` is invoked with a typed slot like `func(int) int`, `lowerTypedLambda` (8131) calls `inferTypeFromGoString` to recover `T.Type` for the param binding map — the recovery returns `T.TVar "_"` for non-primitive shapes, downstream consumers re-derive via `solvedTypeToGo` (env-aware), closing the cycle that produces `<<loop>>` on widened gates.

**Emitted Go today:** Non-primitive function params at call sites of higher-order kernels still route through `rt.SkyCall` reflection wrappers because the binding map drops to `_` and σ-recovery fails.

**Emitted Go fully-typed:** Direct typed calls (`f(n)` not `rt.SkyCall(f, n).(int)`), with `lowerTypedLambda`'s `paramTypeBindings` populated from structural `GoType` not parsed strings.

**Architectural dependency:** Eliminating string round-trip requires `lowerTypedLambda`'s `paramTys :: [String]` to become `[GoType]` (Strategy-C PR 6 per docs), AND `inferTypeFromGoString` to be replaced with `inferTypeFromGoType :: GoType -> T.Type` covering the full shape list (`SkyList`, `SkyMaybe`, `SkyResult`, `SkyTask`, `SkyDict`, `SkySet`, `T2/T3`, `Foo_R[T1,T2]`, `func(A) B`). Independent of Gap 1, but Gap 1 cannot close without it.

## Gap V1 — `inferTypeFromGoString` (Compile.hs:8156-8163) returns `T.TVar "_"` for every non-primitive

**Lying seam.** The whole function:

```haskell
inferTypeFromGoString :: String -> T.Type
inferTypeFromGoString s = case s of
    "string" -> T.TType ModuleName.basics "String" []
    "int"    -> T.TType ModuleName.basics "Int" []
    "bool"   -> T.TType ModuleName.basics "Bool" []
    "float64"-> T.TType ModuleName.basics "Float" []
    "rune"   -> T.TType ModuleName.basics "Char" []
    _        -> T.TVar "_"
```

Five literal arms, then a wildcard that says "I don't know" for **every other Go shape** — `[]int`, `rt.SkyMaybe[T]`, `rt.SkyResult[Error,A]`, `Foo_R[Msg]`, `func(string) any`, `rt.T2[string,int]`, …

**Consumer (lying-seam exploitation).** `lowerTypedLambda` (Compile.hs:8111-8115) builds the lambda-scope binding map by routing each typed param's Go-rendering through this lie:

```haskell
paramTypeBindings = Map.fromList
    [ (n, inferTypeFromGoString gty)
    | (A.At _ (Can.PVar n), gty) <- zip pats paramTys
    , gty /= "any"
    ]
```

So a Sky lambda `\maybeUser -> …` typed at a slot of `func(rt.SkyMaybe[User_R]) Msg` lands in the lambda-scope ledger as `maybeUser ↦ TVar "_"`. Every downstream consumer that calls `lookupLambdaType "maybeUser"` then `solvedTypeToGo`s the result gets `"any"` — the typed information is irrecoverably lost between the typed slot at the call boundary and the body's expression-level type-recovery path.

**Sky shape that exercises the lie.**

```elm

greet maybeUser =
    case Maybe.map .name maybeUser of  -- accessor on the param
        Just n  -> "Hello " ++ n
        Nothing -> "Hi anon"

view : User -> Element Msg
view u = button [ onClick (UseUser u) ] (text (greet (Just u)))
```

**Emitted Go (today).**


```haskell
    GoBare "string" -> T.TType ModuleName.basics "String" []
    GoNamed "rt.SkyList"  [a]   -> T.TType ModuleName.list "List" [inferTypeFromGoType a]
```

# Foundation refactor: "One renderer, period"

## Thesis

The four audits converge on a single root cause: **seven String-typed renderers + one parallel GoType ADT pipeline = eight sources of truth, all expected to agree, none of which actually do**. Every Cause H Step 4 attempt failed because widening one renderer created asymmetry against the other six. Every C17c (Cause G) attempt failed for the same shape of reason — qualified marker tokens leaked through siblings that didn't know about them.

The Plan agent's "C8 MappingContext widening" + "PR 5/6 caller-signature change" is a 12-PR multi-session **migration TO a parallel pipeline**. But `solvedTypeToGo` (R1) is already the env-aware, production renderer. It already consumes `getCgEnv`, `_cg_recordAliases`, `_cg_unionNames`, `qualifiedRuntimeTypedMap`, `globalCurrentDepModule`, `globalUnionNames`. The other six are scar tissue from incremental additions that lacked env access at their introduction point.

**The right architecture is fewer sources of truth, not a more elaborate adapter between two of them.** Delete six renderers. Delete the GoType ADT. Make `solvedTypeToGo` the single canonical producer. Then the gate that closes Cause H is one line; the qualified-marker flip that closes Cause G is one resolver site; the value-side round-trip becomes a structural inverse of one function instead of trying to round-trip through whichever renderer happened to produce the string.

This is the **inverse** of the C8 plan. C8 widens the parallel pipeline until it matches production, then migrates consumers PR-by-PR. "One renderer, period" collapses to production and deletes the parallel pipeline. Same destination, fewer moving parts, and — critically — **no half-migrated tree state** because each PR replaces N call sites with calls into an already-correct function.

## Section 1 — The single canonical representation

**Decision: `solvedTypeToGo :: T.Type -> String` is canonical. Period.**

It produces `String` directly. No intermediate ADT. The value-side speaks `T.Type` (already exists, already authoritative — it's what the HM solver produces); the rendered side speaks `String` (already exists, already what Go consumes). The GoType ADT was a middle layer that only existed because the parallel C1/C2 pipeline needed *some* representation that wasn't `String`. Once we kill the parallel pipeline, the middle layer is dead code.

Why not a typed `GoType` ADT as the canonical form?

- **Audit 2 Gap 13 + Audit 1 R9-vs-R1 divergence**: every time GoType has been used at a production site (the smart-PR4 `solvedTypeToGoTyped` delegate at Compile.hs:15935), it has DIVERGED from production output. `rt.SkyDict` vs `map[string]V`. `Colour_Colour` vs `Colour`. `_Element` vs `Std_Ui_Element`. The C2 parity test points `mapSkyTypeToGo ≡ typeToGo`, not `≡ solvedTypeToGo` — so the ADT is parity-locked to the WRONG production.
- **Audit 3 V13 / V15**: the GoType ADT was supposed to solve the round-trip lossiness. But it doesn't — `renderGoType` is still env-free, and `mapSkyTypeToGo (defaultMappingContext)` still drops the env-aware bits. Adding `MappingContext` widening fields (`cgRecordAliases`, `cgUnionNames`, `cgQualifiedRuntimeTypedMap`, `cgGlobalUnionNames`, `mcCurrentModule`) just rebuilds `getCgEnv` in a parallel struct.
- **`T.Type` already carries everything HM knows.** The solver writes per-region types into `Solve.SolvedTypes`. There is no information `GoType` carries that `T.Type` doesn't — both are isomorphic up to module-prefix resolution, which is an env operation either way.

**The canonical primitives, post-refactor:**

```haskell
-- THE renderer. Reads everything ambiently from getCgEnv (now LowerCtx-threaded).
solvedTypeToGo :: T.Type -> Lower String

-- THE structural inverse. Operates on T.Type directly; no string parsing.
-- (Used at typed-lambda binding sites + σ-recovery + tuple element slots.)
typeOfGoSlot :: GoSlot -> Lower T.Type
  where
    -- A GoSlot is the T.Type at a known position; we don't ROUND-TRIP through
    -- strings, we PROPAGATE the T.Type forward via LowerCtx.
    data GoSlot = SlotKnown T.Type | SlotUnknown
```

`typeOfGoSlot` doesn't parse `"rt.SkyMaybe[Main_User_R]"`. It receives a `T.Type` from the **caller's** LowerCtx — because the caller knew the Sky type of the slot when it called the lowerer. The string round-trip problem (Audit 1 Gap 2/11, Audit 3 V1) disappears by **never producing the string on the path that needs to consume it**.

## Section 2 — How the renderer consumes env-aware data

`solvedTypeToGo` already does. The other six renderers don't because they were introduced before `getCgEnv` existed at their call sites:

| Renderer | Why it has no env | Replacement |
|---|---|---|
| R2 `safeReturnTypeFull` | Predates `getCgEnv` in sig-emission path | Delete — sig emission consults `getCgEnv` directly + calls `solvedTypeToGo` |
| R4 `safeReturnTypeBootstrap` | Pre-env bootstrap (before `getCgEnv` is built) | Delete — bootstrap order changes: build minimal env first, then call `solvedTypeToGo` |
| R5 `safeReturnTypePure` | Dep-module pre-resolve fallback | Delete — dep resolution gets a per-dep env snapshot threaded via LowerCtx |
| R3 `typeStrWithAliasesReg` | TVar-substituting variant with C13/C14 typed siblings | Delete — TVar substitution becomes a LowerCtx σ-map consulted inside `solvedTypeToGo` |
| R6 `solvedTypeToGoPreserveTVars` | TVar-preservation variant for poly-call-site | Delete — preserve-TVar becomes a flag on `solvedTypeToGo` (`renderMode :: PreserveTVars \| EraseToAny \| SubstituteFrom (Map String T.Type)`) |
| R7 `substituteTVarsToGo` | Per-instance σ-substitution | Delete — σ becomes `LowerCtx.lcSigma :: Map String T.Type`, consulted inside `solvedTypeToGo`'s TVar arm |

**The threading mechanism.** `solvedTypeToGo` becomes:

```haskell
solvedTypeToGo :: T.Type -> Lower String
```

where `Lower` is a reader-style monad over `LowerCtx`. The LowerCtx already exists (`Sky.Build.Compile.LowerCtx`); it threads through `exprToGoExpectGo`. We **extend** it with:

```haskell
data LowerCtx = LowerCtx
    { -- existing fields (cgEnv, expectedTy, sigma, ...)
    , lcCgEnv             :: Rec.CgEnv          -- ← was an IORef snapshot via getCgEnv; promote to pure field
    , lcCurrentModule     :: ModuleName.Canonical  -- ← was globalCurrentDepModule IORef; promote
    , lcUnionNames        :: Set String         -- ← was globalUnionNames IORef; promote
    , lcSigma             :: Map String T.Type  -- ← was tvarMap String/String in R3/R7; promote to T.Type
    , lcEnclosingTVars    :: Set String         -- ← was enclosingTypeParamInScope; promote
    , lcRenderMode        :: RenderMode         -- ← preserve-TVars vs erase-to-any vs substitute
    , lcDepEnvSnapshot    :: Maybe Rec.CgEnv    -- ← when rendering dep-module code, the dep's env
    }

data RenderMode = EraseToAny | PreserveTVars | SubstituteFrom  -- consult lcSigma
```

**Two IORef → pure-field promotions** that close audit gaps:

- `globalCurrentDepModule` (Audit 1 Gap 6 — the "Html typed-sibling fires only in entry module" bug) becomes `lcCurrentModule`. R3's `unsafePerformIO (readIORef …)` is replaced with a pure read. Same Sky type → same Go type irrespective of who's calling.
- `globalUnionNames` (Audit 1 R3's `unionRecovery` data source) becomes `lcUnionNames`. R1/R3/R5 agree because they all read the same pure field.

**The big bootstrap question (R4 deletion).** R4 exists because Compile.hs builds `getCgEnv` AFTER some declaration-emission passes need a renderer. The standard objection: "we can't call `solvedTypeToGo` before `getCgEnv` is built."

Two sub-cases:

1. **Decl-emit before env-build** for kernel.json import + alias decl synthesis. These are LITERAL Go declarations; they don't need solver output. They need module-prefix resolution + alias-registry consultation. Both are constructible BEFORE the full solver runs — they only need the canonicalised module + the registered aliases. We split `getCgEnv` into `EnvFloor` (canonicalised + aliases, built early) and `EnvFull` (Floor + solver output, built later). Renderer takes `EnvFloor` in pre-solver positions; takes `EnvFull` post-solver. Same `solvedTypeToGo` function, just a smaller LowerCtx populated in pre-solver paths.

2. **Dep-module rendering** (where R5 lives today). Dep modules ARE solved — they have their own `EnvFull`. Today the dep's env isn't reachable from the entry's LowerCtx; R5 collapses to "any" because of this. Fix: when descending into dep code, swap the LowerCtx's env fields to the dep's snapshot via `lcDepEnvSnapshot`. The `withScopedEnclosingTypeParams` mechanism (Compile.hs already has this for issue #521) is the exact pattern; we extend it to env-swap.

After this, R1's body remains essentially unchanged — its case arms (record-alias lookup, runtime-typed map, qualified-candidate scan, union recovery, parametric-alias `_R[args]` emission, Cmd/Sub `_T[Msg]` emission, Html `_T[Msg]` emission, tuple element rendering) all consult LowerCtx fields. R3/R5/R6/R7 die because their distinct behaviours are now `renderMode` + `lcSigma` + `lcEnclosingTVars` flags on R1.

## Section 3 — The value-side contract

This is where the design pays off. The audits' value-side gaps (Audit 3 V1-V19, Audit 2 Gaps 1-17, Audit 1 Gaps 1-14) all reduce to:

> Strings flow through the value side because consumers can't access the original T.Type.

Once `solvedTypeToGo` is the only producer, we can **expose its input alongside its output** to every value-side consumer.

**The new contract:**

```haskell
-- Instead of:  goRendering :: String  -- and consumers parse it
-- Use:         GoSlot { skyType :: T.Type, goRendering :: String }

data GoSlot = GoSlot
    { gsSkyType     :: T.Type    -- the source of truth
    , gsRendering   :: String    -- solvedTypeToGo gsSkyType — cached
    }

-- Every value-side function that today takes a String takes a GoSlot.
exprToGoExpectGo :: GoSlot -> Can.Expr -> Lower GoIr.GoExpr
emitTypedTuple2  :: GoSlot -> Can.Expr -> Can.Expr -> Lower GoIr.GoExpr
coerceCallArgsAt :: [GoSlot] -> [Can.Expr] -> Lower [GoIr.GoExpr]
coerceToFieldType :: GoSlot -> GoIr.GoExpr -> Lower GoIr.GoExpr
lowerTypedLambda :: [GoSlot] -> GoSlot -> [Can.Pattern] -> Can.Expr -> Lower GoIr.GoExpr

-- And the round-trip lie disappears:
-- DELETE: inferTypeFromGoString :: String -> T.Type
-- DELETE: goTypeStrToSkyType :: String -> T.Type
-- DELETE: parseFuncType / splitCurriedFuncTypeStr / splitFuncTypeStr
-- DELETE: parseTargetArgs (lowerRecordLiteralTo's string parser)
-- DELETE: parametricAliasBase / stripParametric / stripListType / stripMapType (Audit 3 V11)

-- Replace each with structural T.Type operations:
funcArgsOf :: T.Type -> ([T.Type], T.Type)             -- structural peel of TLambda chain
parametricArgsOf :: T.Type -> Maybe (String, [T.Type]) -- structural alias arg extract
tupleElementsOf :: T.Type -> Maybe [T.Type]            -- structural T2/T3/.../Tn elements
```

**The cycle (Audit 1 Gap 11, Audit 3 V1) cannot reform** because `lowerTypedLambda` doesn't parse `paramTys :: [String]` back into T.Type — it RECEIVES the `[GoSlot]` whose `gsSkyType :: T.Type` was carried forward from the parent call. The parent knew. We just propagate, never round-trip.

**Lambda-scope ledger (Audit 3 V12/V13/V18)** changes from `Map String String` (Go-string → Go-string) to `Map (ModuleName.Canonical, Region, String) T.Type` — keyed structurally to eliminate cross-module collision; values are `T.Type` so they're consulted via `solvedTypeToGo` at lookup time, not stored as cached strings. The IORef goes away; LowerCtx threads it pure.

**Sentinel cleanup (Audit 3 V14/V16/V17)**. `T.TVar "_lit"` / `"_empty"` / `"_lambda_arg_*"` / `"_accessor_placeholder"` / `"_unknown"` become a `Solved | Unresolved | Sentinel SentinelKind` ADT. `solvedTypeToGo` rejects sentinels at the entry — non-rendering returns `Maybe String`. Value-side consumers see `Nothing` and route to the safer-but-typed fallback (which is now the only fallback, not the implicit-via-sentinel one).

## Section 4 — Cause G integration

Cause G (FFI interface satisfaction + qualified markers) lands NATIVELY on this foundation:

**The qualified-marker flip (Audit 4 G2).** `FfiTypeResolve.goApp` today returns `Can.TType (Canonical "") "Value" []` for every qualified opaque. Post-refactor:

```haskell
goApp :: BareName -> PkgPath -> [T.Type] -> T.Type
goApp bare pkg args =
    T.TType (Canonical "") (qualifiedNameMangle bare pkg) args
    -- e.g. "CustomerListParams_at_github_com_stripe_stripe_go_v84"
```

The mangled name flows through HM, through LowerCtx, into `solvedTypeToGo`. The renderer's existing `qualifiedCandidates` scan + `qualifiedRuntimeTypedMap` lookup are where the name resolves to either `pkg.CustomerListParams` (with `lcCgEnv` providing the import-alias map) or — under an opt-out — `any`.

**G3 (codegen flatten `_at_pkg` to `pkg.Name`)** becomes a single arm in `solvedTypeToGo`:

```haskell
T.TType _ name args | Just (bare, pkg) <- splitQualifiedMangled name ->
    case lookupImportAlias pkg (lcCgEnv ctx) of
        Just alias -> alias <> "." <> bare <> goArgs args
        Nothing    -> "any"  -- with a build-time warning
```

Today this would have to land at all SEVEN renderers in lockstep; post-refactor it's ONE site.

**G1 (interface satisfaction)** needs a subtyping relation in `Sky.Type.Unify`. That's not a renderer problem — it's an HM problem. But the renderer side of it (consuming `Implements` data to emit `pkg.CanvasObject` from a `*pkg.Label` slot when context demands it) is already in `solvedTypeToGo`'s wheelhouse: the typed-record-alias pipeline does exactly this kind of context-driven choice today (parametric instantiation per call site).

**G5 (inspector emits Implements map)** is purely an inspector + kernel.json change. Independent of renderer refactor. Lands in parallel.

So the Cause G PR sequence becomes: G5 (inspector), G4 (hand-coded sigs migrate to qualified marker), G2 (resolver flip — one line in `goApp`), G3 (flatten arm in `solvedTypeToGo` — one arm), G1 (HM subtyping rule + Implements consultation in unify). Five PRs, each touches one canonical site.

## Section 5 — Migration strategy: no half-migrated state

**The constraint: every commit on `main` MUST build green.** That rules out big-bang.

**The strategy: adapter-shim per legacy renderer, replace call sites in PR-of-N chunks, delete the renderer when its last call site is migrated.**

The trick that makes this work: each legacy renderer R2-R7 today has SOME behaviour R1 doesn't. We don't migrate call sites to R1 directly — we **promote R1 to be a superset of every legacy renderer's behaviour** in PR 0, then migrate call sites one chunk at a time, each chunk verified by the existing example sweep + cabal tests + the canary fixtures the audits identified.

**PR 0 — "Promote R1."**
- Add `RenderMode`, `lcSigma`, `lcEnclosingTVars`, `lcCurrentModule`, `lcUnionNames`, `lcDepEnvSnapshot` to LowerCtx.
- Promote `globalCurrentDepModule` IORef → `lcCurrentModule` (and keep the IORef as a fallback the renderer reads only when `lcCurrentModule = Nothing` — strictly transitional).
- Promote `globalUnionNames` IORef → `lcUnionNames` (same fallback pattern).
- Add the C13/C14 typed-sibling emission (`Cmd_T`, `Sub_T`, `Html_T`, parametric `_R[args]`) — currently only in R3 — to R1, gated on `lcSigma` non-empty.
- Add the `T.TLambda` `func(A) B` arm — currently only in R3 + R4 — to R1.
- Add the qualified-marker resolver arm (G3 flatten) to R1 from day one, behind `lcCgEnv` import-alias lookup. (No-op until G4/G2 land.)
- Tests: cabal test sweep + example sweep MUST pass. No behaviour change visible because R1's new arms only fire when callers populate the new LowerCtx fields, and no caller does yet.

**PR 1 — `safeReturnTypePure` (R5) → R1.**
This is the easiest because R5's "no-env, collapse-to-any" behaviour is R1's `EraseToAny` mode with all extension fields empty. Migrate every R5 call site to call `solvedTypeToGo` with `lcRenderMode = EraseToAny` and empty extension fields. Delete R5. Cabal + sweep MUST pass — output is byte-identical.

**PR 2 — `solvedTypeToGoPreserveTVars` (R6) → R1.**
R6's behaviour is R1 with `lcRenderMode = PreserveTVars`. Migrate call sites; delete R6. Output byte-identical.

**PR 3 — `substituteTVarsToGo` (R7) → R1.**
R7's behaviour is R1 with `lcRenderMode = SubstituteFrom` + `lcSigma` populated. Migrate; delete R7. The R7→R1 fallback path in R7 already exists (Audit 1: "Falls back to **R1** for unknown shapes") — we're removing the wrapper.

**PR 4 — `typeStrWithAliasesReg` (R3) → R1.**
R3 is the biggest behavioural superset (C13/C14, Cmd_T, Sub_T, Html_T, parametric `_R[args]`). PR 0 promoted all of these to R1, so this PR is "migrate call sites + delete R3." Output should be byte-identical for entry-module renders; dep-module renders gain the typed-sibling emission they previously lost (Audit 1 Gap 6 closes here).

**PR 5 — `safeReturnTypeBootstrap` (R4) → R1.**
The bootstrap order needs to change. Build `EnvFloor` early; thread it via LowerCtx. R4 dies. The runtime-typed-map collision (Audit 1 R4 vs R1 — `rt.SkyResponse` vs `rt.HttpResponse` from #467) closes here because there's only one resolver site.

**PR 6 — `safeReturnTypeFull` (R2) → R1.**
R2's "function-types-stay-`any`" rule was a deliberate covariance dodge. We instead push the dodge to the **call site** (lambda-wrap when shape mismatches), not the renderer. PR 6 + the value-side adapter from PR 7 land together so the tree stays green: param sigs become `func(A) B` (typed), call sites that previously passed `any` get a `func(any) any → func(A) B` adapter wrap inserted at the call. This is the Audit 1 Gap 9/10 close.

**PR 7 — Value-side: introduce `GoSlot`. Replace `String` parameters in 4 functions.**
`exprToGoExpectGo`, `coerceCallArgsAt`, `coerceToFieldType`, `emitTypedTuple2/3`. Each gets a parallel `*FromSlot` variant for one PR; the old `String` variants delegate to the new ones by wrapping `String` in `GoSlot { gsSkyType = T.TVar "_lossy", gsRendering = s }` and the new variants degrade gracefully on `_lossy`. Then a follow-up sub-PR replaces call sites one chunk at a time.

**PR 8 — Delete `inferTypeFromGoString`, `goTypeStrToSkyType`, `parseFuncType`, `splitCurriedFuncTypeStr`, `splitFuncTypeStr`, `parseTargetArgs`, the string-stripping family.**
Their last consumers were migrated in PR 7. Delete them. Each line of `stripParametric "rt.SkyResult"` / `stripListType` / `stripMapType` was masking a structural lie; deleting forces every consumer to operate structurally.

**PR 9 — Delete the GoType ADT pipeline.**
`Sky.Generate.Go.Type` (mapSkyTypeToGo / renderGoType / typeToGo). The C2 parity test goes with it. `tupleElementSlots` and `solvedTypeToGoTyped` (Compile.hs:15935) get re-pointed at `solvedTypeToGo`. The `GoTypeAdtSpec` becomes a regression test re-targeted at the canonical renderer's expected output for each shape.

**PR 10 — Cause H Step 4 widening: ONE LINE.**
In `solvedTypeToGo`'s tuple arm:
```haskell
T.TTuple a b extras ->
    let elems = a : b : extras
    in if all isPrimitiveGo (map solvedTypeToGo elems)
         then "rt.SkyTuple2"  -- legacy alias kept for compat
         else "rt.T2[" <> intercalate ", " (map solvedTypeToGo elems) <> "]"
```
becomes:
```haskell
T.TTuple a b extras ->
    let elems = a : b : extras
        rendered = map solvedTypeToGo elems
    in "rt.T" <> show (length elems) <> "[" <> intercalate ", " rendered <> "]"
```
The primitive-only whitelist deletes. The value-side already speaks `T.Type` so the round-trip cycle (Audit 1 Gap 11 / Audit 3 V1) cannot reform. The asymmetry across renderers (Audit 1 R1 vs R3 vs R4) cannot exist because there's one renderer. Audit 2 Gaps 1, 2 close.

**PR 11 — Cause G: G5 (inspector Implements), G4 (hand-coded sig migration), G2 (resolver flip).**
Three sub-PRs; the renderer change for G3 already shipped in PR 0. The inspector + the hand-coded sigs are independent of renderer refactor; they can land in parallel with PRs 1-10 if convenient.

**PR 12 — Cause G: G1 (HM interface subtyping).**
Adds the unification rule in `Sky.Type.Unify`. Renderer side already supports rendering the concrete type when context demands it.

**Tuple aliases for tuple arity ≥ 4 (Audit 2 Gap 3).** Independent PR — runtime addition of `rt.T4` / `rt.T5` / ... up to `rt.T9` (Go's variadic-generics limit). Drops in cleanly post-PR 10.

**User ADT box-erasure (Audit 2 Gap 10) + parametric ADT instantiation (Gap 15).** Independent — value-side ADT emission gets the same `GoSlot` treatment as records.

**Anonymous record IORef phantom (Audit 1 Gap 12).** Closes when `solvedTypeToGo`'s anonymous-record arm emits inline struct literal via `GoStructLit` directly (the GoStruct constructor that R9 has — but R9 is gone, so the constructor migrates to R1's emit path).

## Section 6 — PR count + session estimate

**13 PRs.** Honest count, not optimistic:

| PR | What | Tree stays green? | Sessions |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Promote R1 + LowerCtx extension (no behaviour change visible) | yes (no caller uses new fields) | 1 |
| 1 | R5 → R1, delete R5 | yes (byte-identical output) | 0.5 |
| 2 | R6 → R1, delete R6 | yes (byte-identical) | 0.5 |
| 3 | R7 → R1, delete R7 | yes (byte-identical) | 0.5 |
| 4 | R3 → R1, delete R3 | yes (entry byte-identical, dep gains) | 1 |
| 5 | R4 → R1, delete R4 + bootstrap reorder | yes (env-floor pattern) | 1.5 |
| 6 | R2 → R1, delete R2 + function-type covariance via call-site adapter | yes (paired with PR 7) | 1.5 |
| 7 | GoSlot value-side migration (4 fns + call-site chunks) | yes (parallel old/new) | 2 |
| 8 | Delete the string-parsing helper family | yes (no live callers) | 0.5 |
| 9 | Delete GoType ADT pipeline | yes (no live callers) | 0.5 |
| 10 | Cause H Step 4 (one-line tuple widening) | yes (round-trip cycle structurally impossible) | 0.5 |
| 11 | Cause G: G5+G4+G2 — flip qualified resolver | yes (PR 0's G3 arm already in renderer) | 2 |
| 12 | Cause G: G1 — HM subtyping rule for interface satisfaction | yes (subtyping is conservative widening) | 2 |
| Extras | T4-T9 runtime aliases (Audit 2 Gap 3) + user ADT (Gap 10/15) + anon record (Audit 1 Gap 12) | yes (independent) | 2 |

**Total: ~14 sessions of focused work.** Spread across 4-6 calendar weeks if no compounding blockers. Versus the C8 plan's 12 PRs that build up the parallel pipeline before migrating consumers — comparable PR count, but the failure surface is much smaller because we never have two pipelines disagreeing, and at every PR the tree builds green by construction (each PR either replaces a wrapper with its body, or extends one canonical site).

**The critical risk** is PR 0. It promotes a lot of behaviour at once. The mitigation: PR 0 ADDS arms to R1, conditional on new LowerCtx fields. No existing caller populates those fields, so R1 in PR 0 produces byte-identical output to R1 in PR -1. Verified by full cabal test sweep + 39-example sweep + the audits' canary fixtures (collected to `tools/probe-fixtures/` per audit citations). Every PR after PR 0 is migration mechanics, not design.

**The second risk** is the bootstrap reorder in PR 5. R4 exists because some declaration emission today happens before `getCgEnv` is built. We need `EnvFloor` (module + alias registry, no solver) to be buildable early. Spike that first as a separate investigation PR if uncertain; it doesn't gate PRs 1-4, which can ship in parallel.

**What this design does NOT include** that the C8 plan does: the parallel GoType ADT pipeline. We delete it. The audits collectively spent enormous energy documenting how the parallel pipeline diverges from production. The cheapest way to fix divergence between two pipelines is to have one pipeline.

The v0.17→v0.18 mandate folds in cleanly: the audits' enumerated v0.18 work (canonical T.Type→Go path, structural value-side, qualified-marker flip, interface satisfaction) all land on this foundation. There is no separate v0.18 architectural change required after; the work is the work, done once.

foundationDesigns.design:
# Plan D — "GoType ADT Done Properly"

A foundation refactor that retires every String-typed renderer + tokeniser + sentinel in the codegen pipeline. v0.17 absorbs the v0.18-shape scope per user mandate ("ensure fully typed e2e stands").

---

## 0. Failure-mode triangulation from the four audits

Before the design: the gap inventory consolidates to **three structural lies + one ambient state lie**, on top of which every renderer / value-side / FFI gap is a symptom.

**Lie #1 — Two parallel Sky→Go type mappers diverge.**
Audit 1 R1–R10 + Audit 2 G13 + Audit 3 V7+V15 + Audit 4 H3. `solvedTypeToGo` (env-aware production) and `mapSkyTypeToGo` (env-free GoType ADT) emit different Go strings for Dict / user ADT / parametric record alias / Cmd-Sub typed sibling / Html typed sibling. The C2 parity test pins `mapSkyTypeToGo ≡ typeToGo` — to the WRONG target. Smart PR 4's three concurrent failures (`undefined: rt.SkyDict` + `undefined: Colour` + `[]any vs []Std_Ui_Transform_Prop`) all sit here.

**Lie #2 — Strings carry type identity across every value-side seam.**
Audit 3 V1–V13 + Audit 2 G2 + Audit 1 Gap 11. `inferTypeFromGoString` returns `T.TVar "_"` for every non-primitive; `lowerTypedLambda` takes `[String] paramTys`; `parseFuncType` / `splitCurriedFuncTypeStr` / `splitFuncTypeStr` re-tokenise; `coerceArg` / `coerceToFieldType` / `parseTargetArgs` cascade-match strings; `goTypeStrToSkyType` plants `T.TVar "_unknown"`; σ-projection is `Map String String`; `eraseTypeParams` walks BYTES for `T<digit>`. Every consumer that receives a non-primitive Go-shape string downgrades to `any`-routed lowering, which re-enters production renderers, which produce strings, which the consumer re-tokenises — the cycle that materialised as `<<loop>>` on Strategy-C PR 5+6.

**Lie #3 — FFI qualified opaque collapses to `Value` before unification.**
Audit 4 G1–G5 + Audit 1 Gap 8. `FfiTypeResolve.goApp` parses `Bare@Pkg` then THROWS THE QUALIFIER AWAY. Both `Customer@stripe.../v84` and `Account@stripe.../v84` become `(Canonical "") "Value"` so HM treats them as identical. Hand-coded `Context.background : Value` cross-contaminates. The inspector never emits `types.Implements` relations (only `error`). Three Cause G prerequisites (G2 marker, G3 mangled-name flatten, G5 interface registry) must close together.

**Lie #4 — Renderer behaviour mutates via `unsafePerformIO` IORefs.**
Audit 1 Gap 6 + Audit 1 §"globalCurrentDepModule" + Audit 3 V12. `globalCurrentDepModule`, `globalAnonRecords`, `globalUnionNames`, `globalCgEnv`, `scopeStateRef` (lambda-types ledger), `globalRegionTypes` are all module-level `IORef`s that renderers and lowerers read AMBIENTLY. Same `T.Type` rendered at two call sites with different ambient state produces different Go. This is what makes Lies #1 and #2 unfixable with surface patches — there is no "the" type-mapper because each call sees a different ambient.

The four lies compose: closing #1 fails while #4 holds (ambient diverges); closing #2 fails while #1 holds (strings reach inconsistent producers); closing #3 fails while #1+#2 hold (qualified flow re-tokenises through lossy seams). **The foundation must collapse all four simultaneously** or any one alone reproduces the prior attempts' failure modes.

---

## 1. The Single Canonical Representation — `GoType` ADT (re-grounded)

The existing `Sky.Generate.Go.Type.GoType` ADT is the right shape but is grounded against `typeToGo` (env-free). Re-ground it against the production semantics `solvedTypeToGo` carries TODAY, with explicit arms for every shape the seven legacy renderers handle:

```haskell
-- src/Sky/Generate/Go/Type.hs (rewritten)
data GoType
    -- Primitives
    = GoBare !T.Text                      -- "string" "int" "float64" "bool" "rune" "[]byte"
    | GoAny                               -- the only "lost identity" form, EXPLICIT
    -- Composite generics with structural args
    | GoNamed !GoQualifiedName ![GoType]  -- rt.SkyList[A], rt.SkyMaybe[A], rt.SkyResult[E,A],
                                          -- rt.SkyTask[E,A], rt.SkySet[T], rt.SkyCmd_T[T],
                                          -- rt.SkySub_T[T], Foo_R[A,B], Std_Html_Html_T[T], ...
    | GoMapStringV !GoType                -- Dict K V always: K erased to string, V structural
                                          -- (resolves H3 Dict divergence by mirroring solvedTypeToGo)
    | GoTuple !Int ![GoType]              -- T2[a,b] / T3[a,b,c] / ... / TN slice-backed at N>=4
    | GoFunc ![GoType] !GoType            -- func(A,B,...) R (uncurried, Sky-side curry is separate)
    | GoSlice !GoType                     -- []T for top-level lists not aliased to rt.SkyList
    -- Record alias (env-resolved)
    | GoRecordAlias !RecordAliasId ![GoType]
                                          -- (id, type-args). RecordAliasId is a token bound in
                                          -- MappingContext; render consults the registry.
    -- User-defined ADT, env-resolved
    | GoUnion !UnionId ![GoType]          -- nominal Sky union, parametric-args after C13/C14 dual
    -- FFI qualified opaque (Cause G)
    | GoQualifiedOpaque !QualifiedTypeId  -- Customer@github.com/stripe/...
    | GoInterfaceBridge !QualifiedTypeId  -- CanvasObject@fyne.io/...
                        ![QualifiedTypeId] -- implementors (closed under inspector)
    -- Anonymous record (replaces synthAnonRecordName IORef commit)
    | GoAnonStruct ![(T.Text, GoType)]    -- ordered by canonical sort; structural identity
    -- Generic TVar at declaration / instantiation
    | GoTVar !Int                         -- T1, T2, ... — numeric so substitution is structural
    deriving (Eq, Ord, Show)              -- Eq/Ord/Show are the lingua franca for caching + tests

data GoQualifiedName
    = GoRuntimeBuiltin !T.Text            -- rt.SkyList, rt.T2, rt.SkyCmd_T, ...
    | GoModulePrefixed !ModuleName.Canonical !T.Text
                                          -- Main_View_R, Sky_Core_Error_Error
    deriving (Eq, Ord, Show)

newtype RecordAliasId    = RecordAliasId    { unRecordAliasId :: T.Text } deriving (Eq, Ord, Show)
newtype UnionId          = UnionId          { unUnionId       :: T.Text } deriving (Eq, Ord, Show)
newtype QualifiedTypeId  = QualifiedTypeId  { unQualifiedTypeId :: (T.Text, T.Text) }
                                          -- (bareName, pkgPath)
    deriving (Eq, Ord, Show)
```

**Why this shape passes the adversary review.**

- *No bytewise round-trip*. `GoType` is the SINGLE intermediate. `T.Type → GoType` is one function; `GoType → String` is one function. Consumers (V1/V2/V3/V5/V8/V9/V10/V11) take `GoType` directly. The "tokenise the rendered string then re-parse" cycle has no home.
- *Equality is structural*. `coerceArg`'s string-equality skip-check (V10) becomes `gtSkip :: GoType -> GoExpr -> Bool` with `Eq GoType`. No "stray space" / "alias-rendering choice" divergence.
- *Dict ALIGNS WITH PRODUCTION*. `GoMapStringV` mirrors `solvedTypeToGo`'s `map[string]V` shape. The `rt.SkyDict` ghost goes away. (The runtime never had it.) The C2 parity test is re-pointed to assert `renderGoType (toGoType ctx t) ≡ solvedTypeToGo ctx t`.
- *Cause G is a first-class arm*. `GoQualifiedOpaque` + `GoInterfaceBridge` are explicit constructors. Subtyping (G1) becomes a structural rule on the ADT, not a textual hack.
- *Anonymous records are structural*. `GoAnonStruct` replaces `synthAnonRecordName` + `globalAnonRecords` IORef. Identity = sorted-field shape, not name-hash race.
- *TVar substitution is positional + numeric*. `GoTVar Int`, not name strings. The `eraseTypeParams` byte-walk (V11) is replaced by structural traversal. Sky-source `User_T0` / `Tag_T1` can never collide.
- *No "Cmd Msg" sentinel ambiguity*. Cmd/Sub use `GoNamed (GoRuntimeBuiltin "rt.SkyCmd_T") [arg]` uniformly. The C15 dual-alias is preserved AT THE RENDERER, not at five disagreeing call sites.

**The arms NOT included (deliberately).**

- No `GoString` carrying a parsed-but-unverified type. Consumers that today take strings (`lowerTypedLambda :: [String] → ...`) change signature to `[GoType] → ...` — string is never an intermediate.
- No "unknown" sentinel beyond `GoAny`. Audit 3 V16 lists `_lit` / `_empty` / `_lambda_arg_*` / `_accessor_placeholder` / `_unknown` / `_lc` planted into `T.Type` — these become `Maybe GoType` at the type-inference seam (`inferExprType :: ... → Maybe T.Type` already returns `Maybe`; downstream wraps `toGoType` so the option propagates). Loss is explicit.

---

## 2. `MappingContext` — Snapshotted Environment

The grill against Plan A flagged `globalCurrentDepModule` as unsnapshottable because it MUTATES mid-render via `GoDeclRaw` sentinels. Defuse: refactor the dep-sentinel mechanism so the dep module is a **pure value carried in `MappingContext`**, threaded through render.

```haskell
data MappingContext = MappingContext
    { mcRecordAliases    :: !(Map RecordAliasId RecordAliasInfo)
        -- Snapshot of Rec._cg_recordAliases at compile start. Read-only.
    , mcUnionNames       :: !(Map UnionId UnionInfo)
        -- Snapshot of _cg_unionNames + globalUnionNames.
    , mcRuntimeTypedMap  :: !(Map T.Text T.Text)
        -- bare → rt.* mapping for short-name routing (e.g. Time → rt.SkyTime).
    , mcQualifiedRuntimeTypedMap
                         :: !(Map (ModuleName.Canonical, T.Text) T.Text)
        -- (Sky.Http.Server, Response) → rt.SkyResponse  vs  (Sky.Core.Http, Response) → rt.HttpResponse
    , mcRecordAliasGenericArgs
                         :: !(Map RecordAliasId [T.Text])
        -- record-alias Sky tyvars in declaration order, for σ instantiation
    , mcCurrentModule    :: !ModuleName.Canonical
        -- The MODULE BEING RENDERED RIGHT NOW. Pure value. Set by the caller, not via IORef.
    , mcEntryModule      :: !ModuleName.Canonical
        -- The compile's entry module. For Html dual-alias / dep-vs-entry decisions (Audit 1 Gap 6).
    , mcEnclosingTypeParams
                         :: ![Int]
        -- TVars in scope on the enclosing Go function decl. Drives substituteOnly / eraseFallback.
    , mcCmdSubGenericGate :: !CmdSubGate
        -- TypedAlways | TypedWhenEntry | BareAlways — choice of typed-sibling emission policy
    , mcFfiInterfaceMap  :: !(Map QualifiedTypeId [QualifiedTypeId])
        -- Cause G's structural Implements table. Empty pre-G5; populated by inspector.
    , mcFfiGoImportMap   :: !(Map T.Text T.Text)
        -- pkg path → Go import alias (for G3 codegen flatten).
    , mcAnonStructRegistry
                         :: !(Map [(T.Text, GoType)] T.Text)
        -- Structural → synthesised name. Replaces globalAnonRecords IORef.
        -- Pre-populated by a SINGLE anonymous-record collection pass; never mutated mid-render.
    }
```

**How "snapshot once, pass explicitly" defuses the four ambient IORefs.**

| Today | Tomorrow |
|---|---|
| `globalCgEnv :: IORef CgEnv` read mid-render | `MappingContext` constructed once at compile start, passed as 1st arg |
| `globalCurrentDepModule :: IORef (Maybe ModuleName)` switched via `GoDeclRaw` sentinels | `mcCurrentModule` set by the **decl-emission orchestrator** at the per-decl level — see §3 |
| `globalAnonRecords :: IORef (Map ...)` committed during render | `mcAnonStructRegistry` populated by a pre-pass; render LOOKS UP but never writes |
| `globalUnionNames :: IORef (Set ...)` | `mcUnionNames` snapshot at start |
| `scopeStateRef` (lambda-types ledger) | Threaded explicitly via `LowerCtx`; ledger value is `GoType`, key is `(ModuleName, Region, Name)` |

---

## 3. The `globalCurrentDepModule` defusing — load-bearing detail

Today's mechanism (Audit 1 R3 + Audit 3 V12): `assemble` walks the dep modules' emitted `[GoDecl]`. Between deps, it inserts `GoDeclRaw "// __SKY_DEP_BEGIN <mod>"` sentinels. The renderer detects these strings and IORef-writes `globalCurrentDepModule := Just mod`. Mid-render reads then choose between entry-typed and dep-typed Go (Html dual-alias, parametric-alias arg emission).

**Refactor.** Replace the post-hoc sentinel-and-IORef dance with explicit per-module dispatch BEFORE decls become string:

```haskell
-- New orchestration layer (Sky.Build.Compile.assembleByModule)
assembleByModule
    :: MappingContext           -- ^ entry-module ctx (mcCurrentModule = entry)
    -> [(ModuleName.Canonical, [GoDecl])]  -- ^ dep order
    -> [(ModuleName.Canonical, [GoTopLevelDecl])]
    -- Each output (mod, decls) is rendered LATER with ctx { mcCurrentModule = mod }.
assembleByModule entryCtx perModule =
    [ (mod, lowerDecls (entryCtx { mcCurrentModule = mod }) decls)
    | (mod, decls) <- perModule ]

-- Render: walks the per-module decls with mcCurrentModule set to that module.
renderAll :: MappingContext -> [(ModuleName.Canonical, [GoTopLevelDecl])] -> Text
renderAll entryCtx perModule =
    T.unlines
        [ renderModuleDecls (entryCtx { mcCurrentModule = mod }) decls
        | (mod, decls) <- perModule ]
```

The IORef goes away. `mcCurrentModule` is a stack-passed value at every render call. The `GoDeclRaw "// __SKY_DEP_BEGIN"` sentinel becomes a comment emitted by `renderModuleDecls` itself, no longer load-bearing.

**Asymmetry risk the grill flagged.** Some renderers (notably R7 `substituteTVarsToGo` at Compile.hs:15850) consult `globalCurrentDepModule` to PICK BETWEEN `Foo_R` (dep-form, no args) and `Foo_R[X]` (entry-form, with args). Solution: the parametric-args decision is now a **pure function of (callsite ctx, type)**, not (renderer, ambient). `toGoType` produces `GoRecordAlias id args` REGARDLESS — render-side decides args emission based on `mcCurrentModule == aliasHomeModule`.

**Verification gate (must land in PR 1 of the migration):** a Haskell spec asserts that for every fixture in `tools/probe-fixtures/`, the rendered output is byte-identical when invoked with `mcCurrentModule = entry` vs running the legacy code path. This locks the dep-sentinel refactor at byte-identical parity BEFORE touching the type-mapper.

---

## 4. The Two Canonical Functions

```haskell
-- 4a. T.Type → GoType : ENV-AWARE, the single source of structural truth.
toGoType :: MappingContext -> T.Type -> GoType

-- 4b. GoType → Text : pure, takes RenderEnv for prefix/suffix conventions.
renderGoType :: RenderEnv -> GoType -> T.Text

-- Their composition is the new `solvedTypeToGo`:
solvedTypeToGo :: MappingContext -> T.Type -> T.Text
solvedTypeToGo ctx = renderGoType (mkRenderEnv ctx) . toGoType ctx
```

Every legacy renderer becomes a **caller** of this composition with appropriate `MappingContext` flags:

```haskell
-- R1 → solvedTypeToGo ctx
-- R2 (safeReturnTypeFull) → solvedTypeToGo (ctx { mcFuncTypesStayAny = True })
-- R3 (typeStrWithAliases) → solvedTypeToGo (ctx { mcTVarMap = tvarMap })
-- R4 (safeReturnTypeBootstrap) → solvedTypeToGo (bootstrapCtx, equivalent w/ mcRecordAliases prefilled)
-- R5 (safeReturnTypePure) — DELETED. Callers migrated to R1 with shared env.
-- R6 (solvedTypeToGoPreserveTVars) → solvedTypeToGo (ctx { mcPreserveTVars = True })
-- R7 (substituteTVarsToGo) → solvedTypeToGo (ctx { mcTVarSubst = subst })
```

The flag tuple in `RenderEnv`:

```haskell
data RenderEnv = RenderEnv
    { reCtx              :: !MappingContext
    , reFuncTypesStayAny :: !Bool      -- R2 behaviour
    , rePreserveTVars    :: !Bool      -- R6 behaviour
    , reTVarSubst        :: !(Map Int GoType)  -- R7 behaviour, structural (numeric keys)
    , reCallbackInnerErasure
                         :: !Bool      -- R3 renderHofParamTy covariance dodge (Audit 1 Gap 10)
    }
```

Five legacy renderers collapse to one function with five flags. R5 disappears entirely (its "no env" use case is a *bug*, not a feature — Audit 1 Gap 7 + Audit 2 V7 prove it loses user types systematically). The bootstrap renderer (R4) is shown by the audits to drift from R1 in non-trivial ways (R4 includes `T.TLambda` arm R1 doesn't; R4 uses `runtimeTypedMap` while R1 uses `qualifiedRuntimeTypedMap`); the refactor unifies on R1's superset behaviour. Verification: probe-D3-dep-entry-html-sig + probe-V12-cross-module-helper-collision + probe-J2-pure-renderer-erasure all pass after the unification.

---

## 5. Value-Side Contract — Structural End-to-End

Every value-side seam in Audit 3 takes `GoType`, not `String`. Specific signature changes:

```haskell
-- OLD
inferTypeFromGoString :: String -> T.Type          -- DELETE
goTypeStrToSkyType    :: String -> T.Type          -- DELETE
parseFuncType         :: String -> Maybe ([String], String)         -- DELETE
splitCurriedFuncTypeStr :: Int -> String -> ([String], String)      -- DELETE
splitFuncTypeStr      :: String -> Maybe (String, String)           -- DELETE
parseTargetArgs       :: String -> [String]                          -- DELETE
stripParametric / stripListType / stripMapType / eraseTypeParams /
parametricAliasBase / tvarsInGoTypeStr / substTVarsInGoType /
sanitiseTypedDeep / containsTypeParam / isGenericTypeParam /
splitParametric / splitCurriedFuncStr / containsGenericTypeParam /
goAppearsAsToken                                                     -- ALL DELETE

-- NEW
inferTypeFromGoType   :: GoType -> Maybe T.Type
parseFunc             :: GoType -> Maybe ([GoType], GoType)         -- structural pattern match
goTypeArgs            :: GoType -> [GoType]                          -- already exists from C1
substituteTVars       :: Map Int GoType -> GoType -> GoType         -- structural walk
isEmittable           :: GoType -> Bool                              -- no string registry
isPrimitive           :: GoType -> Bool                              -- structural test
isFuncShape           :: GoType -> Bool                              -- structural test

-- Consumer signature changes
lowerTypedLambda
    :: [Can.Pattern] -> [GoType] -> GoType -> Can.Expr -> GoIr.GoExpr
emitTypedTuple2 / emitTypedTuple3
    :: GoType -> [Can.Expr] -> GoIr.GoExpr            -- takes structural target
exprToGoExpectGo
    :: GoType -> Can.Expr -> GoIr.GoExpr
coerceCallArgsAt
    :: MappingContext -> [GoType] -> [Can.Expr] -> [GoIr.GoExpr]
coerceArg
    :: GoType -> GoIr.GoExpr -> GoIr.GoExpr
coerceToFieldType
    :: GoType -> GoIr.GoExpr -> GoIr.GoExpr
lowerRecordLiteralTo
    :: GoType -> Map T.Text Can.Expr -> GoIr.GoExpr
lookupLambdaType
    :: T.Text -> Maybe GoType                       -- now GoType, not T.Type
lookupLambdaGoStr
    :: T.Text -> Maybe GoType                       -- merge into lookupLambdaType
goExprGoType
    :: Maybe MappingContext -> GoIr.GoExpr -> Maybe GoType
```

**The cycle (Audit 3 V11, V12, V13, Audit 2 cycle through `inferTypeFromGoString` → `lowerTypedLambda`) cannot reform** because there is no string round-trip in the pipeline. `GoType` is the only intermediate.

**Sentinel-collapse rule (Audit 3 V16, V14):** `inferExprType :: ... → Maybe T.Type` keeps its `Maybe` return but the synthetic `T.TVar "_lit"` / `"_unknown"` / `"_lambda_arg_*"` arms are deleted. When a synthetic position cannot be inferred, return `Nothing`. Consumers gate on `Nothing → fall back to GoAny` *with explicit awareness*, not a sentinel sneaking through `solvedTypeToGo`.

---

## 6. Cause G — Native Integration

Cause G shipped with v0.17 scope per user mandate (the four audits prove FFI interface satisfaction is part of fully-typed-e2e, not a v0.18 deferral).

**6a. `FfiTypeResolve.goApp` stops collapsing.**

```haskell
-- OLD: every qualified opaque → Can.TType (Canonical "") "Value" []
-- NEW:
goApp pkg name args
    | Just (bare, pkgPath) <- splitQualified name
        = Can.TType (Canonical "") ("@" <> bare) [...]
            -- bare carries a marker `@` prefix; toGoType recognises it and emits
            -- GoQualifiedOpaque (QualifiedTypeId (bare, pkgPath))
    | ...
```

**6b. Inspector emits `implements` per opaque.**

`tools/sky-ffi-inspect/main.go` extends. For every emitted opaque, walk `types.Implements(t, ifaceT)` for every interface in the inspected `types.Package` set:

```json
{"name":"Label","pkg":"fyne.io/fyne/v2/widget",
 "implements":["CanvasObject@fyne.io/fyne/v2", "Focusable@fyne.io/fyne/v2", ...]}
```

Compiler reads this into `mcFfiInterfaceMap`.

**6c. `Sky.Type.Unify` consults the bridge.** New unification rule:

```haskell
unify (TType _ qBare1 args1) (TType _ qBare2 args2)
    | isQualifiedMarker qBare1 && isQualifiedMarker qBare2 = do
        let q1 = parseQualifiedMarker qBare1
            q2 = parseQualifiedMarker qBare2
        if q1 == q2
            then zipUnify args1 args2
            else do
                ctx <- getCgEnvCtx
                case Map.lookup q1 (mcFfiInterfaceMap ctx) of
                    Just impls | q2 `elem` impls -> ok    -- Label ⊆ CanvasObject
                    _ -> case Map.lookup q2 (mcFfiInterfaceMap ctx) of
                        Just impls | q1 `elem` impls -> ok    -- reverse direction
                        _ -> typeMismatch q1 q2
```

**6d. Codegen flatten via `mcFfiGoImportMap`.** `renderGoType` for `GoQualifiedOpaque (QualifiedTypeId (bare, pkgPath))`:

```haskell
renderGoType env (GoQualifiedOpaque (QualifiedTypeId (bare, pkgPath))) =
    case Map.lookup pkgPath (mcFfiGoImportMap (reCtx env)) of
        Just alias -> alias <> "." <> bare         -- mux.Router
        Nothing    -> "any"                        -- opt-out fallback, with warning
```

**6e. Hand-coded sigs migrate.** `Sky.Type.Constrain.Expression` `lookupKernelType` entries that return `Value` migrate to qualified form. `Context.background : Task Error Context_at_context`, etc. The inspector's qualified-marker output is the source of truth; hand-coded sigs cross-reference it.

**Why this lands inside v0.17.** Once Lies #1, #2, #4 are gone, the qualified marker has somewhere safe to live — `GoQualifiedOpaque` is a structural arm, not a string parse. The four C17c attempts failed because qualified markers flowed through the LYING value-side seams; with the foundation laid, the flip is a localised change.

---

## 7. Migration Strategy — Adapter-Shimmed, Parity-Gated

Big-bang fails: 18,000+ lines of Compile.hs interact across seven renderers + dozens of value-side seams; one PR risks unbuildable trees and lost work. Adapter-shimmed migration with **byte-identical-parity gate** at each step:

**Phase α — Foundation, no behaviour change.**
Each PR lands new ADT / new infra alongside legacy. Existing tests still hit legacy paths. A parity spec (`test/Sky/Build/RendererParitySpec.hs`) compares old vs new output across every probe-fixture; gate is byte-identical until the last PR of each phase.

**Phase β — Per-renderer migration.**
Each renderer migrates one at a time. Adapter wraps legacy callers; parity spec asserts equivalence. When a renderer is migrated, its legacy implementation is DELETED in the same PR (no half-migrated tree).

**Phase γ — Per-value-side-seam migration.**
Each `String`-consuming seam (`lowerTypedLambda`, `coerceArg`, `coerceToFieldType`, `lowerRecordLiteralTo`, `emitTypedTuple{2,3}`, `exprToGoExpectGo`, `lookupLambdaType`) migrates to `GoType`. Adapter at each seam-boundary converts during the transition: `legacyLowerTypedLambda :: [String] → ... = lowerTypedLambdaGT . map parseLegacyGoString`. Adapter dies when last caller migrates.

**Phase δ — Cause G enablement.**
Foundation in place. `FfiTypeResolve` flip; inspector emits Implements registry; Unify reads bridge; renderer emits flattened Go names. The C17c failure modes are structurally impossible at this point.

**Phase ε — Cleanup + deletion.**
All legacy renderers / tokenisers / IORefs deleted. C2 parity test re-pointed (`renderGoType ≡ solvedTypeToGo` on every probe).

**Asymmetry-survives risk defusion.** The grill flagged three asymmetry risks from Plan A attempts:

1. **R4 (bootstrap) drift from R1.** R4 runs before `getCgEnv` exists. Defusion: a **two-stage MappingContext build**. Stage 1 (pre-env) builds `mcRecordAliases` from the dep-summary phase; Stage 2 (post-env) enriches with `mcQualifiedRuntimeTypedMap`, etc. R4's bootstrap caller uses Stage-1 ctx; R1's caller uses Stage-2 ctx. Both call THE SAME `solvedTypeToGo`. The flag tuple in `RenderEnv` distinguishes legitimate behavioural differences (bootstrap can't render parametric-args because aliases aren't fully resolved yet — `reBootstrapRestricted = True` gates that arm).

2. **`globalCurrentDepModule` mid-render mutation.** Defused per §3 — pass `mcCurrentModule` as a value through `assembleByModule`. Render of dep decls happens with `mcCurrentModule = depModule`; render of entry decls with `mcCurrentModule = entryModule`. No mid-render switch.

3. **σ-projection cycle.** Defused by §5 — σ becomes `Map Int GoType`, substitution structural. The `<<loop>>` cycle from `inferTypeFromGoString → solvedTypeToGo → inferTypeFromGoString` cannot reform because the chain never re-enters string-land.

**Migration parity-gate enforcement.** A CI job runs:
```bash
for fixture in tools/probe-fixtures/probe-*; do
    sky-out/sky build "$fixture/src/Main.sky" --emit-go-only > /tmp/new.go
    sky-LEGACY-out/sky build "$fixture/src/Main.sky" --emit-go-only > /tmp/old.go
    diff /tmp/old.go /tmp/new.go && echo "PASS" || (echo "FAIL: $fixture"; exit 1)
done
```
Until Phase δ (Cause G + Cause H semantic close), every PR must pass byte-identical parity against the prior commit's compiler. Phase δ is the FIRST place semantic divergence is allowed — at which point new fixtures (probe-H1-tuple-record, probe-G1-iface-satisfaction, probe-H6-typed-key-let, etc.) become the regression gate.

---

## 8. PR Sequence + Session Estimate

26 PRs across 5 phases. Estimated 8–12 sessions (multi-week per user mandate). Per-PR scope kept ≤ 800 LOC + reverting-clean.

### Phase α — Foundation infrastructure (5 PRs, ~2 sessions)

1. **PR-α1: `MappingContext` skeleton.** Add ADT + `mkMappingContext :: CgEnv → MappingContext` populated from current IORefs. Pass-through only; no callers yet. Parity gate: trivially passes.
2. **PR-α2: `GoType` ADT re-grounded.** New constructors per §1. Keep legacy `mapSkyTypeToGo` alive. Add `toGoType :: MappingContext → T.Type → GoType` (env-aware) and `renderGoType :: RenderEnv → GoType → Text`. C2 parity test re-pointed: `renderGoType (toGoType ctx t) ≡ solvedTypeToGo t` on every probe-fixture.
3. **PR-α3: Anonymous-record pre-pass.** New walker over `[Module]` collects every anonymous record shape; populates `mcAnonStructRegistry`. `synthAnonRecordName` legacy retained but now reads the registry instead of writing the IORef. Parity gate: name choices identical on every fixture.
4. **PR-α4: `assembleByModule` orchestration.** Replace `globalCurrentDepModule` IORef with explicit per-module render. `GoDeclRaw "// __SKY_DEP_BEGIN"` sentinels become inert comments. Parity gate: byte-identical output. **High-risk PR — full probe-fixture sweep required.**
5. **PR-α5: σ-projection structural.** `coerceCallArgsAt`'s σ becomes `Map Int GoType`. `substituteTVars` structural walker. Adapter on legacy-string callers: `legacyCoerceCallArgsAt = coerceCallArgsAtGT . convertSigmaStringsToGoTypes`. Parity gate.

### Phase β — Per-renderer migration (7 PRs, ~2 sessions)

6. **PR-β1: R1 (`solvedTypeToGo`) migrate to `renderGoType ∘ toGoType`.** Behavioural identity preserved via flag tuple in `RenderEnv`. Parity gate.
7. **PR-β2: R3 (`typeStrWithAliasesReg`) collapse to R1 + `reTVarMap`.** Delete R3 implementation in same PR. Parity gate covers C13/C14 typed sibling emission, Cmd/Sub dual-alias, Html typed sibling.
8. **PR-β3: R7 (`substituteTVarsToGo`) collapse to R1 + `reTVarSubst`.** Delete R7. Parity gate covers per-instance σ.
9. **PR-β4: R6 (`solvedTypeToGoPreserveTVars`) collapse to R1 + `rePreserveTVars`.** Delete R6.
10. **PR-β5: R2 (`safeReturnTypeFull`) collapse to R1 + `reFuncTypesStayAny`.** Delete R2. Cause: Audit 1 Gap 9 — the function-types-stay-any rule is a renderer flag.
11. **PR-β6: R4 (`safeReturnTypeBootstrap`) collapse to R1 + Stage-1 ctx + `reBootstrapRestricted`.** Delete R4.
12. **PR-β7: R5 (`safeReturnTypePure`) DELETE.** All callers migrate to R1 with shared env. Audit 2 V7 confirms R5's "no env" was a bug, not a feature. **High-risk PR — exhaustive call-site audit + per-call ctx-thread.**

### Phase γ — Value-side seam migration (8 PRs, ~3 sessions)

13. **PR-γ1: `inferTypeFromGoType`.** New `GoType → Maybe T.Type`. `inferTypeFromGoString` deleted; callers (`lowerTypedLambda`, `coerceCallArgsAt`) take `GoType`. Adapter at boundary. Parity gate.
14. **PR-γ2: `lowerTypedLambda :: [GoType] → GoType → ...`.** Signature change. `parseFuncType` / `splitCurriedFuncTypeStr` deleted; their callers route via structural `parseFunc :: GoType → Maybe ([GoType], GoType)`. Parity gate.
15. **PR-γ3: `coerceArg` structural.** `GoType` equality replaces string equality. Audit 3 V10 fully closes.
16. **PR-γ4: `coerceToFieldType` structural.** Cascade replaced by `GoType` pattern match. Audit 3 V11 closes.
17. **PR-γ5: `lowerRecordLiteralTo` structural.** `parseTargetArgs` deleted. `GoRecordAlias` constructor's args drive substitution. Audit 3 V8 closes.
18. **PR-γ6: `lookupLambdaType` keyed on `(ModuleName, Region, Name)` + value `GoType`.** Merge `lookupLambdaGoStr`. Audit 3 V12/V13/V18 cross-module collision closes.
19. **PR-γ7: `goExprGoType` structural.** Primitive-only gate removed. Returns `Maybe GoType` for any inferable shape. Audit 3 V4 closes.
20. **PR-γ8: `emitTypedTuple{2,3} :: GoType → ...`.** Direct `GoTuple n args` consumption. Audit 1 Gap 14 + Audit 2 G6 closes (tuple literal emission consults tuple structural target).

### Phase δ — Semantic close (Cause H + Cause G) (4 PRs, ~2 sessions)

21. **PR-δ1: Typed-tuple gate widening (Cause H1).** `isTypedTupleElement` accepts any `GoType` other than `GoAny`. Probe-H1-tuple-record + canary-A through canary-J pass. New fixtures become the regression gate. **First semantic divergence from legacy.**
22. **PR-δ2: Cmd/Sub kernel typed migration (Cause H5 + Audit 2 G14 + G17).** `Std_Cmd_batch[T] : []rt.SkyCmd_T[T] → rt.SkyCmd_T[T]`. C15-runtime dual-alias becomes load-bearing. probe-G + probe-V11 close.
23. **PR-δ3: Cause G enablement.** `FfiTypeResolve.goApp` flip + inspector `implements` emission + Unify bridge + render flatten. probe-G1 through probe-G5 close. SKY_FFI_QUALIFIED=1 becomes default.
24. **PR-δ4: Cause H Dict typed-key (Limitation #5).** Let-region propagation through `lookupRegionType` enables typed-key `Dict.toList` on let-bound intermediates. probe-H6-typed-key-let closes.

### Phase ε — Cleanup (2 PRs, ~1 session)

25. **PR-ε1: Delete dead code.** All legacy renderers, tokenisers, IORefs (`globalCurrentDepModule`, `globalAnonRecords`), sentinels (`T.TVar "_lit"` etc.). C2 parity test re-pointed permanently.
26. **PR-ε2: Limitation #7 + #8 close.** Arity-0 application gate (Audit 4 L7); tail-call audit of stdlib non-tail recursion (Audit 4 L8 — partial; full close is a separate stdlib rewrite).

### Session-count honesty

- **8 sessions if every PR lands clean.** ~3 PRs/session sustained.
- **12 sessions realistic** given (a) PR-α4 (`assembleByModule`) is the highest-risk single change and may need 1 full session alone; (b) PR-β7 (R5 deletion) requires exhaustive call-site audit; (c) PR-δ1 is the FIRST place that's semantically allowed to diverge from legacy — debugging will surface unanticipated callers; (d) probe-fixture creation alone (~50 fixtures across the four audits) is ~1 session.
- **Floor: 6 sessions** only if (rare) no rework needed across phases.

### Definition of done

- Every probe-fixture in `tools/probe-fixtures/` builds + runs green.
- Every example in `examples/` builds + runs green.
- `scripts/example-sweep.sh` + `cabal test` + `scripts/verify-all-web.sh` + `scripts/verify-cli.sh` all pass.
- No `IORef` in `Sky.Build.Compile` that influences renderer behaviour.
- No `String`-typed seam in the value-side type-information pipeline.
- `solvedTypeToGo ≡ renderGoType ∘ toGoType` is a Haskell-level identity (not a test assertion).
- Cause G's qualified-marker flow + interface satisfaction is the default, not gated behind `SKY_FFI_QUALIFIED`.
- `docs/v0.17-cause-h-step4-blocker.md` + `docs/v0.17-c17c-asymmetry.md` are marked closed with the PR sequence referenced.

---

## 9. Why this plan defeats the prior attempts' grills

| Grill objection on prior attempts | Plan D's structural answer |
|---|---|
| "Single-site widen at R1 breaks vs R2/R3/R5/R7 asymmetry" | All seven renderers collapse to ONE function pre-widening (Phase β). When widening fires (Phase δ), there is no asymmetric sibling left. |
| "Five-site widen triggers `<<loop>>` through `inferTypeFromGoString`" | `inferTypeFromGoString` deleted (PR-γ1). The cycle has no string round-trip seam left. |
| "Smart shared `shouldTypedTuple` fails `undefined: rt.SkyDict` + `undefined: Colour`" | `toGoType` consumes `MappingContext`'s alias + union maps from the same env-aware source `solvedTypeToGo` already uses. The two no longer diverge. |
| "`globalCurrentDepModule` IORef can't snapshot — it mutates mid-render" | `assembleByModule` orchestration (PR-α4) makes `mcCurrentModule` a pure per-decl value. The IORef goes away. |
| "Smart PR 4's `[]any vs []Std_Ui_Transform_Prop` list-of-records asymmetry" | `GoRecordAlias` + `GoSlice` are structural ADT arms; list element type lowering consults `goTypeArgs` directly. No string-level asymmetry surface. |
| "FFI qualified marker reaches lying value-side seams (C17c blast)" | Phase γ closes value-side seams BEFORE Phase δ flips qualified markers. By the time `Customer@stripe.../v84` reaches a seam, that seam is `GoType`-typed and recognises `GoQualifiedOpaque`. |
| "Cause G interface satisfaction has no place in the type system" | `GoInterfaceBridge` is a structural arm; `Sky.Type.Unify` rule consults `mcFfiInterfaceMap` registered by inspector. Closed at the unification layer, not as runtime coercion. |
| "Migration leaves tree half-broken for weeks" | Every PR ≤ 800 LOC, parity-gated byte-identical until Phase δ. Each PR atomically retires N legacy components. Bisection-safe. |
| "Can't tell when fully-typed-e2e is 'done'" | Definition-of-done section §8: no IORef behaviour, no `String`-typed value-side seam, `solvedTypeToGo ≡ renderGoType ∘ toGoType` at the Haskell type level, all probes green, Cause G default-on. |
